// RQ-CF-PRG-ADDLISTITEM-NEW-COLUMN-NUMERIC-001 / VR001+002.
const fs=require('fs'),assert=require('assert'),crypto=require('crypto'),{execFileSync}=require('child_process');
const fixture='tests/fixtures/vfp9-addlistitem-new-column-numeric/';
const hash=b=>crypto.createHash('sha256').update(b).digest('hex');
const entries=fs.readFileSync(fixture+'counter-v2-frozen-original-inputs.sha256','utf8').trim().split('\n').map(l=>{const m=l.match(/^([a-f0-9]{64})  (.+)$/);assert(m);return [m[1],m[2]];});
assert.equal(entries.length,270);assert.equal(new Set(entries.map(e=>e[1])).size,270);
const caller='src/runtime/prg_engine_runtime_surface_object_methods.inl';
assert.deepEqual(entries.filter(([h,f])=>hash(fs.readFileSync(f))!==h).map(e=>e[1]),[caller],'all269 other frozen inputs unchanged');
const original=execFileSync('git',['show','337156b342ff5e59db88859ededf6580066f3355:'+caller],{encoding:'utf8'});
assert.equal(hash(original),entries.find(e=>e[1]===caller)[0]);
const diff=execFileSync('git',['diff','--no-ext-diff','--unified=0','337156b342ff5e59db88859ededf6580066f3355','--',caller],{encoding:'utf8'}).split('\n');
assert.equal(diff.filter(l=>l.startsWith('@@')).length,1,'one insertion region');
assert.equal(diff.filter(l=>l.startsWith('-')&&!l.startsWith('---')).length,0,'no old source deletion');
const added=diff.filter(l=>l.startsWith('+')&&!l.startsWith('+++')).map(l=>l.slice(1));assert.equal(added.length,24);
const insertion=added.join('\n')+'\n',current=fs.readFileSync(caller,'utf8');
assert.equal(current.split(insertion).length,2,'unique insertion');assert.equal(current.replace(insertion,''),original,'existing ID predicate/body and all shared fallbacks byte-identical');
assert(insertion.includes('!find_native_list_control_row_by_item_id'));
assert(insertion.indexOf('std::isfinite')<insertion.indexOf('static_cast<long long>(supplied_id')));
assert(insertion.indexOf('std::trunc')<insertion.indexOf('static_cast<long long>(supplied_id')));
assert(insertion.includes('supplied_id.number_value <= 32767.0'));
assert(insertion.includes('checked_addlistitem_new_column_argument(supplied_column, behavior)'));
assert(insertion.includes('InvalidArgument"), 11)'));assert(insertion.includes('admitted_no_write = *column == 0U'));
for(const token of ['arguments.size() == 3U','materialized_unbound','PrgValueKind::string','PrgValueKind::number','PrgValueKind::int64','PrgValueKind::uint64','RQ-CF-PRG-ADDLISTITEM-NEW-COLUMN-NUMERIC-001','VR-5611-ADDLISTITEM-NEW-COLUMN-NUMERIC-001/002','#7186'])assert(insertion.includes(token),token);
assert.equal((current.match(/checked_addlistitem_new_column_argument\(/g)||[]).length,1);
console.log(JSON.stringify({originalInputs:270,unchangedInputs:269,changed:[caller],insertedLines:24,oldCallerRecoveredByteIdentical:true,callerSHA256:hash(current),note:'Structural scope audit, NOT runtime/fixed/hostile/preservation acceptance.'}));
